{{Top|leg}}
'''Cholo''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[Master Coder]] Chip, Cholo pointed out that the device was best used on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with low [[Computer/Legends|computer]] sophistication, such as the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
